stories.title: The Sleepy Bear
stories.text: Once upon a time, a little bear named Boo felt very sleepy. He opened his mouth and yawned a big yawn. Yaaawn! He found a soft bed of leaves. The moon smiled and said, Good night, Boo. Boo closed his eyes. Sweet dreams, little bear. The end.

stories.title: The Happy Duck
stories.text: Dolly the duck loved the rain. Splash, splash, splash! She jumped into a puddle. Her friend the frog jumped in too. Splash, splash! They laughed and played all day. Then the sun came out and made a beautiful rainbow. The end.
